invoice.title: Invoice
invoice.preview_error: Could not check what can be invoiced. Please try again.

not_billable.NOT_CONTROLLED: The shipment is not marked as controlled. Mark it as controlled before invoicing it.
not_billable.NOT_ACTIVE: The shipment is not active and cannot be invoiced.
not_billable.ALREADY_INVOICED: The shipment has already been invoiced.
not_billable.ARCHIVED: The shipment is archived and is not included in invoicing.
not_billable.NOT_FOUND: Shipment not found or it does not belong to this client.

supplier.title: Supplier invoice
supplier.external_number_hint: External number from the supplier invoice

invoice.remediate_confirm: This invoice was rejected by SDI. Issue a credit note (TD04) to void it and reassign its shipments?

select.title: Invoice by selection
select.pick_client: Pick a client to see its billable shipments

invoice.popup_blocked: Allow pop-ups to view the invoice

credit.hint: The credit note (TD04) is linked to the original invoice and copies its lines.
credit.partial_hint: Tick the lines to credit and adjust the net amount of each one. VAT is worked out from each line's rate.
credit.hint_partial: The server checks that the total credited does not exceed what is still left to credit on the invoice.
credit.issue_net_over: The selected net amount exceeds what is still creditable.
credit.issue_vat_over: The selected VAT exceeds the VAT still creditable.
credit.issue_fully_credited: This invoice is already fully credited.

why.title: Why: tax rules applied
why.intro: These configurable rules produced the invoice lines and the amount payable.
why.none: No configurable rule acted on this invoice: it was calculated with the standard rules.
why.invoice_rules: Rules acting on the whole invoice
why.held: Sending is on hold because of a rule:
why.held_no_permission: Only a TMWE operator with admin permission can release it.
why.released_by_rule: Sending was held by a rule and then released:
why.release_intro: The invoice will be verified and certified again and can then be sent. Who releases it and why is recorded.
why.cambios: Compared with the normal calculation, {n} rule(s) changed this invoice: {lista}.

numbering.title: Invoice numbering
numbering.intro: Each series numbers invoices independently. The operator picks which one to use when creating an invoice.
numbering.empty: No numbering series configured yet. Invoices use the legacy sequential number.
numbering.readonly_notice: You do not have permission to change the numbering configuration.

field.codice_hint: Stable identifier, cannot be changed later
field.label: Name
field.is_default_hint: Only one series per document type

warn.format_changed: Changing the format mid-period means invoices in the same year will look different. Make sure this is intended.
warn.mixing: Invoices in this period were already issued with another series: {series}. Mixing series within the same fiscal period may be read as non-sequential numbering.

delete.title: Delete series
delete.note: If it has issued invoices it will only be deactivated: its numbers stay auditable.

ranges.title: Validity ranges
ranges.intro: A range sets the number format and the first number for a period of dates. Closing a range cannot be undone.
ranges.none: No ranges defined for this series.
ranges.valid_to_hint: Leave empty for an open range
ranges.close_warning: Closing a range is irreversible: it stops being valid from the date you choose.
ranges.reason_hint: Required; it is kept in the change log
ranges.preview_confirm: Nothing is saved yet. Confirm to create the range.

envios.title: Tax authority submissions
envios.intro: Every issued and certified invoice appears here, ready to be reported to the tax authority through its partner and country channel. The status only changes with a receipt: with the MANUAL intermediary, download the file, upload it to the portal and then upload the official receipt.
envios.first_of_series: First number of a new series

autofactura.label: Self-invoice
autofactura.hint: Self-invoice / integration document for a foreign supplier invoice
autofactura.xsd_hint: Self-invoices skip the verifier: they are validated against the FatturaPA XSD when generated and again when sent
autofactura.verification_ok: Self-invoice {td}: XML validated against the FatturaPA XSD and the self-invoice is active. It does not use the verifier certificate.
autofactura.verification_ko: The self-invoice is cancelled or its XML was not validated against the XSD.

verification.none: Not certified: the verifier has not checked this invoice yet.
verification.ko: The verification found differences: the invoice is not certified.

upload.title: Upload official receipt
upload.intro: Invoice {numero} · channel {canal}. Upload the receipt exactly as downloaded from the portal (SDI RC, NS, MC, NE; Peppol response; sent email).
upload.declared: Outcome (only if the email is not recognised)

toast.sent_manual: {n} file(s) generated: upload them to the portal and then upload the receipt

empty.aceptadas: No accepted submissions with these filters

fiscal.title: Tax configuration
fiscal.intro: Every tax rule has an inclusive start and end date. A row that has already been applied is never edited or deleted: close it and create another one with «Change from date». Every change asks for a reason and is logged.
fiscal.motivo_hint: Required: stored in the change log with your user

tabla.valori: Values by charge, country and partner

hint.condicion: SIEMPRE, NACIONAL, B2B, PA… Combine with & and negate with !
hint.regex: Regular expression without delimiters; empty = free

filters.partner_hint: Its rows and the general ones

form.new_intro: The row is rejected if it overlaps another one with the same scope. Rows with a future start date are allowed.

change.title: Change from date
change.intro: The current row is closed the day before the given date and a new row is created with the changed values. Example: VAT from 22 % to 24 % from 1 January.
change.desde_hint: The current row will end the day before
change.last_applied: Last known application of the current row: {fecha}

end.close_intro: Sets the end date without a successor. It can only be shortened, never extended, and not before its last application.
end.deactivate_intro: Only for rows that have never been applied (for example a future row loaded by mistake).
end.applied_until: The row has already been applied (last time: {fecha}): it cannot be removed; end it or change it from a date.
end.applied: The row has already been applied: it cannot be removed; end it or change it from a date.

intermediari.intro: Adding an intermediary requires its adapter (bin/fisc intermediario:alta). Here you can view them and switch TEST / PROD mode after testing.
intermediari.mode_intro: Transmissions already sent keep their intermediary. Switch to PROD only after testing with canal:test.

revision.intro: Overlaps, gaps (days without a valid row) and rows expiring without a successor. This is the daily valores:check, extended to parameters, requirements, channels and deadlines.

alertas.close_intro: Alerts close by themselves when the cause disappears. Close it manually only if it is already solved.

datos.title: Tax data
datos.no_country: The issuer country could not be determined: requirements are not checked.
datos.required: Data required by the validation table
datos.none_required: The validation table requires no data for this entity on this date.
datos.bad_format: The value does not match the key format
datos.set_intro: If the key already has a current value, it is closed the day before and the new one is created.
datos.bad_route: Invalid route: expected cliente, partner or usuario and an id.
datos.values_hint: The active exception wins; otherwise the data where it already lives (client record, site or configuration files).

cond.valores_hint: Type and press Enter to add
cond.catalog_error: The field catalog could not be loaded. Use the shortcut field or reload the page.
cond.intro: The rule applies when these conditions are met.
cond.atajos: Shortcuts that can be inserted as rows
cond.atajos_hint: NACIONAL, INTRA_UE_*, EXTRA_UE and RUTA: compare two fields with each other: type them in the shortcut field (no builder).
cond.vacia: No conditions: the rule always applies.
cond.not_editable: This JSON condition cannot be edited with the builder. It is kept as is:
cond.use_builder_hint: Combines fields, operators and values; replaces the text shortcut.
cond.atajo_solo_texto: no row equivalent: type it in the shortcut field
cond.atajo_no_etapa: its fields do not exist at this stage
cond.atajo_insertar: click to insert the equivalent rows

atajo.NACIONAL: issuer and customer in the same country
atajo.INTRA_UE_B2C: intra-EU with a customer without VAT
atajo.LETTERA_INTENTO: customer with a valid letter of intent
atajo.DOMESTICA: pickup and delivery in the issuer country

err.unknown_dato: Row {path}: field {dato} is not in the catalog
err.unavailable: Row {path}: field {dato} is not available at stage {etapa}
err.op_invalid: Row {path}: operator {op} is not valid for a {tipo} field
err.value_type: Row {path}: the value is not of type {tipo}
err.list_empty: Row {path}: add at least one value
err.between_pair: Row {path}: enter the minimum and the maximum
err.between_order: Row {path}: the minimum cannot exceed the maximum
err.param_key: Row {path}: invalid parameter key (capitals, digits, dot or underscore)
err.empty_group: Group {path}: add at least one condition

reglas.title: Rules by pipeline stage
reglas.aviso: These are the rules of each stage of the invoice calculation: configurable rules (exemptions, different VAT, withholdings, stamp duty, legal mentions, blocks…) plus the value and requirement rules. A new rule starts as a draft, is previewed on the invoices still to be issued and only applies once active.

politica_desc.fijar: Set: when several rules match, the most specific one wins.
politica_desc.acumular: Accumulate: all matching rules apply, in priority order.
politica_desc.bloquear: Block: one matching rule is enough.

reglas.sin_reglas: No rules configured at this stage.
reglas.aviso_doble: Activating a rule needs the signatures of two different operators.
reglas.aviso_simple: In this environment one signature is enough to activate a rule (two-signature check disabled).
reglas.legacy: Value and requirement rules (edited in their own tabs)

conflictos.title: Rule conflicts
conflictos.ninguno: No other rule overlaps with this one in the same stage.

preview.bloqueadas_con: {n} would be blocked by the rule
preview.bloqueadas_sin: {n} were already blocked without the rule
preview.nada_que_comparar: There are no shipments pending invoicing in that period and scope: nothing to compare. Try another period.
preview.sin_afectadas: The rule does not change any invoice in this period.

avisos.EMPIEZA_DESPUES: The rule starts on {inicio}, after the simulated invoice date ({fecha}): it will have no effect in this preview. Change the invoice date.
avisos.ACABA_ANTES: The rule ends on {fin}, before the simulated invoice date ({fecha}): it will have no effect.
avisos.SIN_EXPEDICIONES: There are no shipments to invoice in the period: nothing to compare. Try another period.
avisos.TRUNCADO: Only the first {limite} clients were simulated; narrow the period or choose a client.

accion_dialog.close_intro: An applied rule is neither edited nor deleted: it is closed with an end date and, if needed, another one is created. Closing it changes the tax configuration of the affected partner, who will need to be revalidated.
accion_dialog.deactivate_intro: Only a rule that has never been applied can be removed. If it was already applied to an invoice, close it instead.
accion_dialog.data_fine_hint: It cannot be earlier than the last invoice that applied the rule.

wizard.etapa_intro: Choose at which point of the invoice calculation the rule acts. Each stage only sees data computed in earlier stages.
wizard.ambito_intro: Who does the rule apply to? Leave a field empty to apply to everyone. The more specific the scope, the more specific the rule.
wizard.partner_hint: Search by name or tax ID; empty = all
wizard.cliente_hint: Search by name or tax ID; empty = all
wizard.condicion_intro: When does the rule act? With no rows, whenever the scope matches. Only data available in the chosen stage is offered.
wizard.accion_intro: Choose what the rule does. The form is generated from the action.
wizard.textos_idiomas: Text in each language (one is enough)
wizard.prioridad_hint: Breaks ties between rules of the same scope; higher number = first
wizard.rif_hint: Article or rule that justifies it
wizard.codigo_hint: Optional; one is generated if empty
wizard.guardar_intro: Review the summary and save the rule as a draft. A draft is not applied to any invoice. Next comes the preview, which is mandatory.
wizard.preview_intro: The preview simulates the rule on the pending invoices of the scope and period without saving anything: you will see which invoices change and by how much. It is mandatory before activating and only valid for this version of the rule.
wizard.preview_guarda_antes: Save the draft first (previous step): the preview runs on the saved version.
wizard.preview_partner_hint: Required if the rule is general
wizard.preview_fecha_hint: Decides which rules are in force; empty = last day of the period
wizard.preview_obligatoria: The preview of this version of the rule is missing. It is mandatory to activate it.
wizard.activar_doble: Two signatures: activating gives the first signature and the rule stays pending. Another operator (not the creator and not you) must approve it from this same tab. Once active, the affected partner needs revalidation.
wizard.activar_simple: In this environment one signature is enough: the rule becomes active. The affected partner needs revalidation.
wizard.queda_pendiente: First signature given. The rule is pending approval by another operator.
wizard.pendiente_info: The rule has the first signature (user {user}) and awaits a second one from another operator. Approving makes it active; rejecting returns it to draft.
wizard.objetivo_intro: What do you want to achieve? Pick a goal; the system decides at which calculation stage the rule acts.

acciones_desc.FIJAR_VALOR: %, fixed amount, minimum and maximum of a charge
acciones_desc.AJUSTAR_PORCENTAJE: Adds points to the % set by another rule (e.g. fuel +2 % for one client)
acciones_desc.EXCLUIR_DE_BASE: Removes a component from the taxable base of a tax
acciones_desc.INCLUIR_EN_BASE: Adds a component to the taxable base of a tax
acciones_desc.FIJAR_TIPO: Changes the VAT rate (e.g. reduced rate)
acciones_desc.EXENCION: VAT 0 with Natura, legal reference and wording (N1…N7; BT-120 and BT-121 in UBL)
acciones_desc.INVERSION_SUJETO_PASIVO: Reverse charge (N6.x or AE) with its mandatory wording
acciones_desc.ESIGIBILIDAD: VAT chargeability: immediate (I), deferred (D) or split payment (S, Italian PA)
acciones_desc.BOLLO: Virtual stamp duty when the exempt amount exceeds the threshold (DatiBollo)
acciones_desc.MENCION: Legal text in the PDF and in the XML (Causale)
acciones_desc.RETENCION: Withholding (ritenuta, DatiRitenuta): deducted from the amount payable, not from the base
acciones_desc.BLOQUEAR: The invoice is not issued and the FACTURA_BLOQUEADA alert is opened
acciones_desc.RETENER_ENVIO: It is issued but held in the sending queue

acciones_nombre.EXCLUIR_DE_BASE: Take something out of the taxable base
acciones_nombre.INCLUIR_EN_BASE: Put something into the taxable base

areas.envio: How and when it is sent

areas_ayuda.panorama: Whether each partner can invoice in its country and, if not, what is missing. Click a row to see its full sheet.
areas_ayuda.cobramos: Amounts and taxes of each charge and the rules that change them for a country, partner or client.
areas_ayuda.exige: The data the law requires to issue and each country's parameters.
areas_ayuda.envio: Where and in which format each invoice is sent, who delivers it and by when.
areas_ayuda.control: Overlaps and gaps in the configuration and open alerts.

panorama.intro: Red: cannot invoice or has no sending channel. Amber: invoices, but sending is held or there are alerts. Green: ready.

ficha.que_falta: What is missing to invoice normally
ficha.lista: All set: this partner can invoice and send in this country.

vacio.impuesto: No tax rows: they must be added before invoicing.
vacio.canal: No sending channel: invoices would have nowhere to go.
vacio.reglas: No active rules for this partner and country.

supplier_list.control_failed: Could not change the review status.

xml.intro: Upload the invoice file your supplier sent you (.xml or .p7m). You can review it before saving.
xml.err_too_big: The file is larger than 5 MB.
xml.read_failed: The invoice could not be read. Please try again.
xml.import_failed: The invoice could not be saved. Please try again.
xml.no_supplier: This supplier is not in your list yet. Create it first, then upload the invoice again.
xml.plan_xml: As set out in the invoice.
xml.plan_default: The invoice has no due dates: they were calculated from the supplier's usual terms.

monthly.title: Monthly billing
monthly.no_storage: Exclude shipments with open storage or follow-up
monthly.err_range: The start date must not be after the end date.
monthly.load_failed: The preview could not be calculated.
monthly.uncertain: We did not receive confirmation of the issuing. It was not retried. Check below and in the invoice list what was issued before issuing again.
monthly.rejected: The server rejected the request. Nothing was issued.
monthly.rep_stopped_user: Issuing was stopped by you after a batch.
monthly.rep_stopped_uncertain: Issuing STOPPED because the server did not answer (network error, timeout or server error). It was not retried.
monthly.rep_stopped_rejected: Issuing STOPPED because the server rejected a batch.
monthly.rep_uncertain: Batch {n} of {total} is UNCERTAIN: it may have been partly issued. Check the invoice list before issuing again.
monthly.rep_rejected: Batch {n} of {total} was rejected; nothing was issued in it. {detail}
monthly.rep_next: The preview was refreshed: clients already invoiced no longer appear. Review it before issuing the rest.
monthly.res_nothing: Nothing to bill or already billed
monthly.nothing: There is nothing to bill in this period.
monthly.date_before_dal: The date cannot be before the start of the period.
monthly.confirm_text: Invoices will be issued for {n} customer(s), totalling {total}, dated {date}.
monthly.irreversible: Issued invoices are tax documents and cannot be undone.

carrier.title: Carrier reconciliation
carrier.intro: Upload the detail your carrier sends with its invoice and check whether what it charges matches what was expected for each shipment.
carrier.none: There are no shipments to show.
carrier.accept_text: You will absorb this difference as your own cost. Enter the reason.
carrier.recharge_text: The difference will be calculated and made ready to charge to the customer.
carrier.load_failed: The shipments could not be loaded.
carrier.err_bad_type: Only CSV or text files are accepted.
carrier.err_too_big: The file is larger than 20 MB.
carrier.import_failed: The file could not be read. Check that it comes from the chosen carrier.
carrier.action_failed: The action could not be completed.
carrier.checks_hint: What the file left when it was loaded: matched rows, overruns, duplicates, rows not found, or already reconciled on another invoice.
carrier.checks_none: No saved issues for this invoice.
carrier.checks_load_failed: The issues could not be loaded.
carrier.overview_hint: Since {from}. Pick an invoice to reconcile it.
carrier.overview_none: There are no carrier invoices to show.
carrier.overview_failed: The invoice list could not be loaded.
carrier.register_failed: The invoice could not be registered.
carrier.err_new_amount: Enter a net amount above 0 and a non-negative VAT.
carrier.link_hint: Add shipments the file did not include to this invoice. A shipment already on another invoice is not overwritten.
carrier.link_ids: Shipment numbers (separated by commas, spaces or new lines)
carrier.link_result: {linked} linked, {already} were already on this invoice.

exports.empty: The server returned no file for this period.
